#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Auto-cli: a demonstration of an automatic command-line application.
Usage: python auto_cli.py --input <file> --operation <count|summarize>
"""

import argparse
import sys
import os


def parse_arguments() -> argparse.Namespace:
    """Parse and validate command-line arguments."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Automatically process a file based on the specified operation.",
        usage="%(prog)s --input FILE --operation {count,summarize}",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--input",
        required=True,
        help="Path to the input file (required).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        required=True,
        choices=["count", "summarize"],
        help="Operation to perform: 'count' or 'summarize' (required).",
    )
    # argparse will automatically handle missing required arguments
    # and print a diagnostic message with usage, then exit.
    return parser.parse_args()
